# iNEST_Interconnect

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
An in-network neuromorphic interconnect architecture that embeds spike-based computation and routing directly within the communication fabric. It is central to iNEST's goal of merging computation with communication for event-driven, brain-inspired systems.
